a_propos.intro: Rihanala Village was born from a vision: to offer the East Coast of Madagascar an exceptional welcoming space where families, groups and travellers meet in a natural setting 800 m from the sea.
a_propos.histoire_text: Opened in early 2021, Rihanala Village has grown across 15,000 m² in Mahavelona (Foulpointe). Our domain lives up to its name — 'Rihanala' means 'one who delights in the forest' in Malagasy. Every space and bungalow was designed to blend comfort, authenticity and respect for the environment.
a_propos.mission_text: To be the reference venue for group stays, spiritual retreats, corporate seminars and family holidays on the East Coast of Madagascar. To offer warm service, functional spaces and quality cuisine in an unforgettable green setting.
a_propos.valeur_1_text: Personalised welcome for every visitor, from a 60-person group to a couple on a getaway.
a_propos.valeur_2_text: Spaces in harmony with Malagasy nature, far from standardised accommodation.
a_propos.valeur_3_text: Carefully maintained facilities and trained staff to meet all your expectations.
a_propos.cta_text: Whether for a family holiday, a seminar or a spiritual retreat, our team is here to help.
